title: Dr. Andrew Huberman Joins Hims & Hers Board of Directors
summary: World-renowned neuroscientist and tenured Stanford professor brings valuable expertise to the company on making the latest health innovations accessible and actionable.
body_markdown:
Dr. Huberman is a world-renowned neuroscientist and tenured professor in the Departments of Neurobiology and Ophthalmology at Stanford University School of Medicine. He has authored or co-authored more than 75 peer-reviewed articles in respected scientific journals including *Nature* , *Science, Cell, Neuron, Current Biology,* and *Journal of Neuroscience.* Research from his laboratory at Stanford, the Huberman Laboratory, has advanced our understanding of brain development, neural plasticity, and the neural mechanisms of stress and resilience.


Dr. Huberman has become a trusted cultural voice on the latest health and wellness science for people all over the world. As the host of the podcast Huberman Lab, the most popular health and science podcast in the world, he translates science into real-life protocols for millions of people, and his book *Protocols: An Operating Manual for the Human Body* is a #1 *New York Times* bestseller.


“Andrew Huberman has done more than almost anyone to make rigorous science accessible and actionable for millions of people,” said Andrew Dudum, CEO and co-founder of Hims & Hers. “As we continue to build the future of personalized, science-backed healthcare, his expertise in neuroscience and human health will sharpen how we think about the science behind our offerings. We’re thrilled to welcome him to our board of directors.”


“Tools to significantly improve human health are emerging faster than ever,” said Andrew Huberman. “Everyone deserves access to the best possible healthcare and tools to feel great. Hims & Hers provides the ideal platform to deliver personalized health. I’m delighted to join the board of Hims & Hers because they are clearly the leaders in this effort, and are transforming an industry of personalized healthcare that, in the past, has been too slow to prioritize everyday people. I’m incredibly proud to be part of the mission to set a new standard for delivering personalized healthcare that allows everyone to feel their absolute best in terms of health, vigor, and longevity.”


Dr. Huberman joins a multi-disciplinary board that includes experts in clinical practice, pharmaceuticals, regulatory affairs, retail, technology, and foreign policy. He will also serve as a scientific and brand marketing advisor to Hims & Hers and separately provide additional marketing support to the company through the Huberman Lab podcast.
